mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in the month preceding the prediction triggers a term premium compression, lowering discount rates and thereby increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% in the month before prediction
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day moving average of the pre-signal month, or term premium expansion is observed via a rising 10Y Treasury yield.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation acceleration (measured by CPIAUCSL rising by ≥0.3% month-over-month for two consecutive months) raises expected real interest rates, which reduces the present value of equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL month-over-month increase ≥0.3% for two consecutive months
regime_hint: Accelerating inflation in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically different from a baseline of negative 1% during similar inflation regimes, or 10Y Treasury yields fall below 2.5% during the same horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment growth (PAYEMS rising by ≥10,000 monthly) coinciding with a decline in unemployment (UNRATE falling by ≥0.2 percentage points) signals a strong labor market, prompting optimism about corporate earnings and pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥10,000 and UNRATE decreases by ≥0.2pp in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns remain negative despite similar labor indicators in prior months, or correlation between PAYEMS/UNRATE and SPX 5-day returns is <0.3.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO falling by ≥5% month-over-month) accompanied by a decline in retail sales (HOUST falling by ≥3% month-over-month) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which depresses equity valuations and predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO month-over-month fall ≥5% AND HOUST month-over-month fall ≥3%
regime_hint: Demand contraction in a recessionary cycle
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during analogous demand contractions, or industrial production recovers without a parallel rebound in SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in capacity utilization (RSAFS falling by ≥2 percentage points for three consecutive months) suggests approaching supply constraints, raising expected future volatility and compressing option values, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls by ≥2pp for three consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the 30-day average during prior supply-constrained periods, or capacity utilization recovers without a corresponding equity pullback.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of declining unemployment (UNRATE below 4% for two consecutive months) without a corresponding rise in wage growth (implied by a flat or declining GDPC1 trend) suggests a healthy but non-inflationary labor market, which supports optimism and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% for two consecutive months AND GDPC1 trend does not rise
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during analogous labor market conditions, or wage growth (GDPC1) rises in parallel with SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the 2-year Treasury yield (implied by FEDFUNDS falling below 1.75%) during a period of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL month-over-month increase ≥0.2%) indicates the Fed is cutting real rates to combat sticky inflation, which supports equity valuations and predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than a baseline during prior inflation-control periods, or 2Y Treasury yield does not fall as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in consumer confidence (implied by a single month of HOUST falling by ≥15%) predicts near-term pessimism about demand, which elevates risk premia and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls by ≥15% in the prediction month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during analogous confidence drops, or consumer confidence recovers without a corresponding equity decline.
